findings.problem: AuthorizationResolver.granted_scopes returns only directly assigned project IDs, while point authorization and the separate S04 granted_scopes helper follow roll-down edges. A parent-project grant can therefore read a child directly and see its requisitions, but the projects list omits that child.
findings.fix: Consolidate the two granted-scope implementations and make list scopes expand project descendants using the same roll-down semantics as effective-access checks.

findings.problem: Delegation dates are converted at midnight in the browser timezone rather than the organization timezone required by the story. A user working in another timezone creates a shifted active delegation window, and other viewers can see different boundary dates.
findings.fix: Resolve the period in the organization timezone, preferably by sending calendar dates for server-side conversion or by supplying the organization timezone to a timezone-aware conversion.

findings.problem: The unselected Organization tab has tabIndex=-1 but the tab widget has no arrow-key handler, so keyboard-only users cannot focus or activate that tab.
findings.fix: Implement the same roving-focus arrow/Home/End keyboard behavior used by the approval inbox tabs, with tab IDs and an associated labelled tabpanel.

findings.problem: Reason is validated as required, but it has no required marker and its inline error has no ID or aria-describedby association, so the requirement and validation message are not programmatically conveyed.
findings.fix: Mark Reason as required consistently with the other fields and connect a stable error element ID through aria-describedby.
